transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on continuously for about two and a half years, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy mood.

During these past two and a half years, have there been any periods of a few weeks or longer where your mood was significantly worse, or has the intensity of your sadness remained relatively stable throughout?

I'm not quite sure and haven't really tracked it, but it feels like it has just been a consistently low and heavy mood throughout the entire two and a half years. It hasn't really fluctuated much, but rather has just been a constant weight.
During this time, have you consistently experienced other symptoms like changes in your appetite, difficulty sleeping, low energy, or feelings of worthlessness?
No, I haven't really experienced those specific symptoms. My appetite and sleep have been mostly normal, and I wouldn't say I've felt worthless.
Have you ever had a period during these two and a half years where you felt completely symptom-free, or has the low mood been present for more days than not throughout this entire time?

No, I haven't had any periods where I felt completely free of this sadness. The low mood has been present almost every single day for the entire two years and five months. It has just felt completely continuous without any break at all.
During this time, have you found that you have lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, or has your ability to feel enjoyment remained largely unchanged?
Yes, I've completely lost interest in the hobbies and activities I used to love doing. It feels like I just can't experience any sense of pleasure or enjoyment anymore, no matter what it is.
Have you noticed any persistent difficulty with your ability to concentrate, focus, or make decisions during this time?
No, I haven't really noticed any issues with my concentration or focus. Making decisions hasn't really been a problem for me either, as far as I can tell.
Beyond the feelings of sadness, have you noticed a persistent sense of low self-esteem or feeling inadequate compared to others over these past two and a half years?
No, I haven't really noticed a persistent sense of low self-esteem or felt inadequate compared to others. My view of myself has remained relatively normal despite the sadness.

latest_inference.note: The patient describes a chronic, low-mood state lasting over two years, which is the hallmark of Persistent Depressive Disorder. Although they lack some of the typical associated symptoms (like sleep/appetite changes or low self-esteem), the presence of anhedonia and the duration meet the primary criteria. I am keeping this as the sole candidate as no other diagnostic criteria (like mania, psychosis, or ADHD symptoms) have been endorsed.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a continuous, unremitting low mood lasting for 2.5 years, which meets the duration criteria for Persistent Depressive Disorder. While the patient reports anhedonia, they lack the vegetative symptoms (sleep/appetite changes) and cognitive symptoms (worthlessness/poor concentration) typically required for a Major Depressive Episode, supporting a diagnosis of Persistent Depressive Disorder.
